MOFA logo kit

SVG (vector, scale to any size)
  mofa-icon.svg             icon that switches light/dark automatically (CSS media query) – good for README on GitHub
  mofa-icon-light.svg       icon for light backgrounds
  mofa-icon-dark.svg        icon for dark backgrounds (lifted teal)
  mofa-icon-mono-white.svg  one-colour icon for teal/dark fills, print, merch
  mofa-icon-mono-dark.svg   one-colour icon for light fills
  mofa-lockup-light.svg     icon + "MOFA" wordmark + full name, light backgrounds
  mofa-lockup-dark.svg      same, dark backgrounds
  mofa-lockup-mono-white.svg

PNG
  mofa-icon-1024.png        transparent, for the GitHub repository avatar / social cards
  mofa-icon-512/180/48/32/16.png   app-icon and favicon sizes
  mofa-lockup-light-1800.png / mofa-lockup-dark-1800.png   wide header images
  mofa-banner-1200x630.png  social preview used on the website (Open Graph)
  github-social-preview-1280x640.png  same design at GitHub's recommended size -> repo Settings > Social preview
  github-readme-banner-2400x600.png   wide header for the top of README.md (SVG versions included)
  favicon.ico               16/32/48 multi-size

Colours
  teal #2BA3AF / #037F8C / #046672   apple #BF1304   leaf #6F890B
  dark mode: #5FC4CF / #2BA3AF / #0E8A97, apple #D9261A, leaf #8FAE1F
  Wordmark font: Fredoka 700 (Google Fonts)

Note: the SVG banners reference the Fredoka font. Fredoka-Bold.ttf is included; install it (or open the PNGs) to see them as intended.
